## Type of change

- [ ] New check
- [ ] Bug fix / false-positive fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Added/updated tests (checks need a vulnerable **and** a safe fixture case)
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (dev deps are fine)
- [ ] Updated docs (`docs/checks.md` for new checks) and `CHANGELOG.md`

## For new checks

- [ ] Findings carry reproducible `evidence`
- [ ] The check is non-destructive
- [ ] False-positive story (describe below)
